segments.text: Bose planned the daring Great Escape with the help of his nephew Sisir Kumar Bose in a car from his Elgin Road residence.
Disguised as a Pathan named Ziauddin with a long beard, he slipped past British CID surveillance undetected.
Bose escaped across the rugged northwest frontier, traveling across Afghanistan and the Soviet Union to reach Germany.
In Berlin, Germany, Bose organized Indian legionaries to swear an oath to liberate India from British rule.
